# CPDataKit v0.6.1

- NetCDF, Zarr 3 and Parquet now save and restore CPDataKit metadata, including units, provenance,
  validation summaries, schema references and mappings. Older files remain readable.
- A failed Zarr replacement restores the old output. If rollback also fails, the exception note
  gives the path to the saved backup.
- Failed application operations now set the job and catalog status to `failed`. Job polling returns
  the service error and validation findings.

This release keeps Python >=3.12 and the v0.5 public compatibility contracts. CLI/workbench format
integration and selection loading performance stay as in v0.6.0.

```shell
python -m pip install --upgrade cpdatakit==0.6.1
```

Storage details and recovery steps are in docs/format-metadata.md.
